name: Aurora Veil
author: nimitz (ported)
description: Looking up into a volumetric procedural aurora — green curtains overhead warming toward magenta near the horizon, over a starfield. Stars keep the beat on the downbeat; the veil breathes with the music's intensity and its colour warms with the mood. Ported from nimitz's 'Auroras'.
caption: Looking up into an aurora — green curtains overhead across a starfield, warming toward magenta near the horizon. The stars keep the beat on the downbeat, while the veil breathes with the music's intensity and its colour warms with the mood.
